scripts.check: npm run check -w @talo/ui && node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.workers.json --noEmit
scripts.prepare:bundle: npm run build:workers && node scripts/bundle.mjs && npm run verify:bundle
scripts.package: npm run vendor && npm run prepare:bundle && tauri build --config apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json
scripts.package:offline: npm run vendor && npm run prepare:bundle && tauri build --config apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json --config apps/desktop/tauri.offline.conf.json
scripts.package:release: npm run vendor && npm run prepare:bundle && tauri build --config apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json --config apps/desktop/tauri.release.conf.json
